subheadline: No Desiderio version ships until static analysis, the template audit and the full test suite pass. We maintain these checks for you.

items.title: PHPStan level 8
items.description: Static analysis checks the whole codebase at level 8 on every change.

items.title: Automated template audit
items.description: The audit allows no inline styles and no fixed colours in any of the 244 element templates.

items.title: Tests on every supported PHP version
items.description: Unit and functional tests run on every supported PHP version before each merge.
